name: War-Awoken Aurochs Burst (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒オーラカバースト
effects:
Single-target Water/NE piercing ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Water Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold to all targets with at least 0/40% Imperil Water
WS Blue: Imperil Water 30% to all enemies
WS Gold: DeProtect 20% to all enemies
